added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate arms: its manifest and classification.json carry baseline_suite null and after_suite null, because the node's write paths hold no test file and it ran no suite. With no arm recorded there is no head-to-base delta to compute, so the added-failure count is zero on the absence of arms rather than on a measured green run.

findings.text: follow-on: the probe row's enrichment seconds read 279.2 while the scope's own record gives 224.2 (reprocess-progress-bulk-4.json:52 enrichment.seconds and logs/probe-psc.log "Time: 224.2s"), so the table's four rows sum to 1861.6 against the 1806.6 total it states at line 61 and the fragment cannot be reconciled with the JSON it renders.

follow-on: the a048717-subset scope declares ids 700 at line 119 but its post-reset control census totals 713, because the reset focus (scratch/chunk-b.json, logs/chunkB-reset.log) named 13 b260008 signals while the scope's final census (n_ids 700) omits them, so the zero-discovered tally and its own control measure different populations and the 13 remain at discovered (scratch/discovered_now.json).

follow-on: the probe scope's post_reset_census is null although logs/probe-psc.log records "Reset 120 FacilitySignal nodes", so the node's declared control covers only three of its four scopes and 120 of the 2597 finished signals pass with no evidence the reset ran before enrichment.

follow-on: the control paragraph states the DCSV scope read "751 of 753 signals at discovered with described=0", but its own census (census-chunkD-postreset.json and reprocess-progress-bulk-4.json:88) records described 2, so the fragment overstates what the reset cleared.
